about: Vectors for ap2/checkout-mandate/x402. The checkout mandate and checkout JWT are ap2-checkout-mandate.json's built M and J, whose bound H is that file's fixed H; M's checkout_hash is the SHA-256 of J, base64url (fixed.checkoutHash). The x402 credential is AP2's bundle as its reference credential provider writes it (google-agentic-commerce/AP2 e1ea56d, code/samples/python/src/roles/x402_credentials_provider_mcp/server.py:162-163 and :205-219): the authorization's nonce is keccak-256 of the payment mandate chain's UTF-8 text, here computed by js-sha3 0.13.0's keccak256, the check AP2's payment processor makes (x402_psp_mcp/server.py:147-157). The payment mandate chain is AP2's published open Payment Mandate (the open hop of docs/ap2/payment_mandate.md line 534 at e1ea56d, whose SHA-256 is fixed.publishedSha256) chained with a closed Payment Mandate written as AP2's SDK writes it, by node:crypto and the JSON text of Python's json.dumps: a kb+sd-jwt whose delegate_payload references one disclosure of mandate.payment.1, its transaction_id the checkout's hash (AP2 specification.md:154-155; payment_mandate.json's transaction_id; shopping_agent_v2/shopping_agent/mandate_tools.py:809-814), its nonce the payment nonce, its sd_hash the open hop's digest as AP2's published closed hop has it. fixed.published is AP2's published chain whole: its transaction_id is the hash of AP2's published checkout, another checkout than this one. The signatures are placeholders, since nothing here verifies one. Accounts and amounts are AP2's sample's shapes.
